description: This file declares the API functions for the Dslh Cpe Controller object, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization routines. It serves as an interface for external modules to interact with the Cpe Controller component within the DSL Home Model system.

methods.name: DslhCreateCpeController
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Cpe Controller instance, given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: DslhCpecoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Cpe Controller object with specified contexts.

methods.name: DslhCpecoRemove
methods.description: Removes a Cpe Controller object instance.

methods.name: DslhCpecoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the Cpe Controller instance.
